audience: practice managers at direct primary care clinics who run memberships in Hint Health

useCases.title: Find the practice's locations near a postal code
useCases.text: The AI lists the practice's locations with address, phone, virtual flag and location group, optionally near a postal code, and opens one by id.

useCases.title: Review practitioners, specialties and panel sizes
useCases.text: The AI lists practitioners with bio, NPI, specialties, panel size and limit, enrollment settings and locations, so you can see who has room for new members.

useCases.title: List membership plans and coupons
useCases.text: The AI lists the plans with their type (company, retail or sponsor fixed fee) and the coupons with code, discount, duration, redeemable window and archive state.

useCases.title: Review the services and products you charge for
useCases.text: The AI lists charge items with code, name, price, category and stock, for a price list check or to find items to update.
